text: Based on the tool output, there is no evidence of tree-cover loss on this asset after 2020. The baseline date for observation is December 31, 2020, and the latest observed year is 2025. The European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) data confirms that 43.3 hectares of the asset were forest in 2020. Although the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD) data shows tree cover in 2000, there is no indication of tree-cover loss in the years following the 2020 baseline. Therefore, it can be concluded that no tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020.
